sn47.23:1.4: “Friend Ānanda, what is the cause and reason for the decline of the true Dhamma?
sn47.23:1.5: And what is the cause and reason for the nondecline of the true Dhamma?”…
sn47.23:2.7: “It is, friend, when these four establishments of mindfulness are not developed and cultivated that the true Dhamma declines.
sn47.23:3.7: And it is when these four establishments of mindfulness are developed and cultivated that the true Dhamma does not decline.”
